hypotheses.L1_late_compactness_replicates: At least seven of eight cleaned late address operators have K90 at most 2 on the independent covariance slice.
hypotheses.L2_compact_addresses_beat_random_directi: Median cleaned-address operator K90 is at most one quarter of the median matched random-direction K90 at both layers.
hypotheses.L3_full_linearization_predicts_small_edi: At edit scale 0.25, full-operator prediction error is at most 2% of intervention KL for every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.L4_rank1_predicts_compact_address_edits: For every address with K90 at most 2, rank-one prediction error is at most 10% of intervention KL at scale 0.25 on every corpus.
hypotheses.L5_top128_native_channels_predict_compac: For every address with K90 at most 2, top-128-channel prediction error is at most 10% of intervention KL at scale 0.25 on every corpus.
hypotheses.L6_compact_programs_have_recurrent_simpl: At least four of eight addresses have a same-polarity current/next token feature with signed AUROC at least 0.75 on all three corpora.
hypotheses.L7_rank1_behavior_degrades_at_finite_sca: Median rank-one relative error at scale 1.0 is at least twice its value at scale 0.25.
hypotheses.L8_final_layer_is_more_rank1_behavioral: At scale 0.25, Layer 11 median rank-one relative error is at most half Layer 10 median error.
